section_summary: This section records Japanese requests for naval vessels to visit Philippine ports from 1931 to 1935 and the State Department’s coordination with War, Navy, and other departments to extend customary courtesies. It also documents changed itineraries, questions about how permission should be requested, and concern that some requests arrived too late to notify the ships before departure. The final page begins an informal notification concerning the transport Ondo.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note requesting courtesies for Yahagi
subfiles.about: Yahagi plans visits to Iloilo, Cebu, and Manila.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies and gives the proposed itinerary.

subfiles.title: State Department referral of Yahagi request to War
subfiles.about: State asks War to approve and arrange courtesies for Yahagi.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note and requests instructions to Philippine authorities.

subfiles.title: State Department notice of Yahagi visit to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to extend customary courtesies to Yahagi.
subfiles.summary: Lists Iloilo, Cebu, and Manila visit dates.

subfiles.title: Reply to Japanese Ambassador on Yahagi
subfiles.about: Philippine authorities have been instructed to welcome Yahagi.
subfiles.summary: Confirms arrangements for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of Yahagi arrangements
subfiles.about: War has cabled the Philippine command about Yahagi.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to extend courtesies and notify the Governor General.

subfiles.title: Revised Yahagi itinerary
subfiles.about: Cholera prompts a possible substitution of Zamboanga for Iloilo and Cebu.
subfiles.summary: Requests courtesies at Zamboanga, while retaining a possible Cebu visit.

subfiles.title: State referral of revised Yahagi itinerary
subfiles.about: State seeks War’s response to Yahagi’s proposed Zamboanga visit.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the revised Japanese request.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for 1931 Training Squadron visit
subfiles.about: Yakumo and Idzumo plan to visit Manila in July.
subfiles.summary: Names the squadron’s commanders and requests customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State reply on 1931 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: State confirms arrangements for the squadron’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the request and reports action to secure customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy of 1931 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: State requests Navy courtesies for Yakumo and Idzumo.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note about the July Manila visit.

subfiles.title: Notice to War of 1931 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: State requests War courtesies for Yakumo and Idzumo.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note about the July Manila visit.

subfiles.title: War approval of Yahagi’s Zamboanga visit
subfiles.about: War has instructed Philippine authorities to extend courtesies at Zamboanga.
subfiles.summary: Reports cable instructions and notice to the Governor General.

subfiles.title: State reply on Yahagi’s Zamboanga visit
subfiles.about: Philippine authorities have been advised of Yahagi’s possible Zamboanga visit.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for 1931 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: War has directed Philippine command to welcome Yakumo and Idzumo.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the July Manila itinerary and confirms instructions.

subfiles.title: State confirmation to Navy of 1932 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Iwate and Asama plan a March visit to Manila.
subfiles.summary: Confirms an earlier telephone notification.

subfiles.title: Protocol note urging War letter
subfiles.about: The Bureau of Insular Affairs awaits written notice of the squadron visit.
subfiles.summary: Urges prompt transmission of the War Department letter before the bureau acts.

subfiles.title: State confirmation to War of 1932 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: State confirms the expected Iwate and Asama visit to Manila.
subfiles.summary: Follows an earlier telephone communication.

subfiles.title: State reply on 1932 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Federal authorities have been informed of Iwate and Asama’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for 1932 Training Squadron visit
subfiles.about: Iwate and Asama plan to visit Manila from March 18 to 21.
subfiles.summary: Names the squadron commander and ship captains and requests courtesies.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for 1932 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: War has cabled the Philippine command about Iwate and Asama.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions to extend courtesies and notice to the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Protocol routing note
subfiles.about: The note concerns information on the squadron’s proposed visit.
subfiles.summary: Brief handwritten filing or routing instruction.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on missing notice
subfiles.about: Major Ashbridge reports no official notice of the Japanese squadron visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests prompt clarification and action on notice to the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Kuma visits
subfiles.about: Kuma proposes March visits to Zamboanga and Iloilo.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether the visits are convenient to the United States.

subfiles.title: State referral of Kuma request to War
subfiles.about: State asks War to extend courtesies to Kuma.
subfiles.summary: Describes the Zamboanga and Iloilo itinerary.

subfiles.title: State referral of Kuma request to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to extend courtesies to Kuma.
subfiles.summary: Describes the Zamboanga and Iloilo itinerary.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Japanese chargé on Kuma
subfiles.from: R. Walton Moore for Secretary of State
subfiles.about: State is consulting federal authorities on Kuma’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further reply when their responses arrive.

subfiles.title: Navy letter about proposed 1934 Training Squadron visit
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to a proposed Japanese squadron visit to Manila.
subfiles.summary: Notes that a formal request should pass through the State Department.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Taketomi about Kuma permission
subfiles.about: Taketomi asks whether notification alone suffices for Kuma’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Dooman explains the custom of seeking permission for foreign armed vessels. Taketomi withholds his note pending an answer and offers to make a formal request. An attached note distinguishes Kuma from the previously discussed training squadron.

subfiles.title: Bureau of Insular Affairs memorandum on Kuma
subfiles.about: The Governor General sees no objection to Kuma’s visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays the Governor General’s approval without limitations.

subfiles.title: War inquiry about Asama and Iwate
subfiles.about: The Governor General asks how to classify and approve Asama and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: Quotes a radiogram seeking guidance on their proposed Manila visit.

subfiles.title: Protocol handwritten note on squadron inquiry
subfiles.from: Division of International Conferences and Protocol
subfiles.about: Office notes concern the pending training squadron inquiry.
subfiles.summary: Brief, largely illegible handwritten notation.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs note on absent squadron request
subfiles.about: No official Japanese request for the training squadron appears to have arrived.
subfiles.summary: Attaches the earlier Navy letter to the Japanese naval attaché.

subfiles.title: Protocol handwritten note
subfiles.about: The note concerns consultation with the Bureau of Insular Affairs.
subfiles.summary: Largely illegible internal notation.

subfiles.title: Protocol note on prior ship visits
subfiles.about: Protocol finds no recent formal request for Asama and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: Mentions earlier United States visits by the ships.

subfiles.title: Baldwin’s notice of Governor General’s inquiry
subfiles.about: The Governor General seeks guidance on a March visit by Asama and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: Provides the radiogram in advance of formal War Department correspondence.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Kuma
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to Kuma’s Zamboanga and Iloilo visits.
subfiles.summary: Promises to instruct naval commanders to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Final approval of Kuma visits
subfiles.from: William Phillips for Secretary of State
subfiles.about: The United States agrees to Kuma’s March visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms arrangements for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War response on Kuma
subfiles.about: War has instructed its Philippine command to welcome Kuma.
subfiles.summary: Also asks the Bureau of Insular Affairs to notify the Governor General.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for 1934 Training Squadron visit
subfiles.about: Iwate and Asama plan to visit Manila from February 28 to March 3.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador names Vice Admiral Hajime Matsumoto and Captains Kiyoshi Hara and Taiji Ota. He asks that the ships and their personnel receive customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State approval and referral of 1934 squadron to War
subfiles.about: State sees no objection to Iwate and Asama’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies and lists the squadron’s commanders.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1934 squadron to Navy
subfiles.about: State requests Navy courtesies for Iwate and Asama.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the ambassador’s request.

subfiles.title: State reply on 1934 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: State is arranging courtesies for Iwate and Asama.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the commanders named in the Japanese request.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for 1934 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: War has instructed Philippine authorities to welcome Iwate and Asama.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the commanders’ names were passed to the Philippine command.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of 1934 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to Iwate and Asama’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Promises to inform naval commanders.

subfiles.title: File note on reciprocal naval visit arrangements
subfiles.about: Navy is willing to simplify reciprocal arrangements for Japanese naval visits.
subfiles.summary: References a Protocol memorandum about avoiding discrimination.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for 1935 Training Squadron visits
subfiles.about: Yakumo and Asama plan visits to Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Names Rear Admiral Kamesaburo Nakamura and requests courtesies for the ships and personnel.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to Interior
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to Labor
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to War
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to Navy
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of 1935 squadron to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Yakumo and Asama at Manila and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed March and June dates.

subfiles.title: State approval with notice-timing request
subfiles.from: William Phillips for Secretary of State
subfiles.about: State approves Yakumo and Asama’s visits but asks for earlier notice in future.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone approval of visits to Manila and Honolulu. Phillips explains that the short notice would have prevented a refusal from reaching the squadron before its Manila departure.

subfiles.title: Protocol memorandum on local notification
subfiles.about: Japanese ships sought a Manila visit through local notice.
subfiles.summary: Records advice that permission should instead be requested through diplomatic channels in Washington.

subfiles.title: Navy response on 1935 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Navy raises concern about late notice of the squadron’s Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: It does not object to the visits and will notify naval commanders, but urges earlier future notifications.

subfiles.title: War response on 1935 Training Squadron
subfiles.about: War directs Philippine and Hawaiian commands to extend courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Also requests notice to the Philippine Governor General.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements at Honolulu
subfiles.about: Honolulu customs officials will extend courtesies to the squadron.
subfiles.summary: Treasury notes that Manila lies outside its jurisdiction.

subfiles.title: Immigration service arrangements at Honolulu
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner of Immigration and Naturalization
subfiles.about: The Honolulu district director will extend lawful courtesies to squadron personnel.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the planned Yakumo and Asama visits.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Tatsuta visits
subfiles.about: Tatsuta proposes visits to Jolo, Davao, Cebu, and Legazpi.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval and customary courtesies; the first port is miswritten as Tolo.

subfiles.title: Protocol clarification of Tatsuta port names
subfiles.from: Division of International Conferences and Protocol
subfiles.about: The Japanese Embassy clarifies that Tatsuta will visit Jolo and Legazpi on Luzon.
subfiles.summary: Resolves Tolo as Jolo and distinguishes two places named Legaspi.

subfiles.title: State referral of Tatsuta request to War
subfiles.about: State seeks courtesies for Tatsuta’s proposed Philippine itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Lists Jolo, Davao, Cebu, and Legazpi dates.

subfiles.title: State referral of Tatsuta request to Navy
subfiles.about: State seeks courtesies for Tatsuta’s proposed Philippine itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Lists Jolo, Davao, Cebu, and Legazpi dates.

subfiles.title: Interim reply on Tatsuta
subfiles.about: State has referred Tatsuta’s itinerary to interested federal departments.
subfiles.summary: The note incorporates corrections made by telephone to the port names. State promises a further reply when the departments respond.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s response on squadron visit
subfiles.to: Ernest Gruening; forwarded to Department of State
subfiles.about: Hawaii has no objection to Yakumo and Asama visiting Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Promises customary courtesies during the June visit.

subfiles.title: Japanese revised Tatsuta itinerary
subfiles.about: Tatsuta’s Jolo, Davao, Cebu, and Legazpi dates are advanced.
subfiles.summary: Provides revised dates from April 22 through May 19.

subfiles.title: State notice of revised Tatsuta schedule to War
subfiles.about: State forwards Tatsuta’s revised Philippine itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Updates the four port dates.

subfiles.title: State notice of revised Tatsuta schedule to Navy
subfiles.about: State forwards Tatsuta’s revised Philippine itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Updates the four port dates.

subfiles.title: State acknowledgment of revised Tatsuta schedule
subfiles.about: Federal authorities have been notified of Tatsuta’s revised schedule.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further response in due course.

subfiles.title: War response on initial Tatsuta itinerary
subfiles.about: War has cabled instructions to extend courtesies to Tatsuta.
subfiles.summary: Also seeks notice to the Philippine Governor General.

subfiles.title: War acknowledgment of revised Tatsuta itinerary
subfiles.about: War has cabled Tatsuta’s revised schedule to Philippine command.
subfiles.summary: Requests corresponding notice to the Governor General.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Tatsuta visits
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to Tatsuta’s Philippine visits.
subfiles.summary: Promises to inform naval commanders to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Final State reply on Tatsuta
subfiles.about: Federal authorities are arranging customary courtesies for Tatsuta.
subfiles.summary: Confirms arrangements following the revised itinerary.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs routing request
subfiles.about: The office asks Protocol to notify War and Navy.
subfiles.summary: Brief handwritten instruction concerning the next notification.

subfiles.title: Informal notification of Ondo visit
subfiles.about: The Japanese transport Ondo will visit Manila while carrying crude petroleum.
subfiles.summary: Miura informally gives the October 11–13 dates under the 1930 arrangement, while procedure for unarmed public vessels remains unsettled.
